cs.t: I don’t think it would have been possible for the last 12 years. But should be possible  now . Only the 2021 spec for usb pd supports 36v (common bike battery voltage) and more than 100W delivery. My bosch ebike charges at 36v 4A. I also think that a small usb c connector could easily break when used in an ebike. But this should not prevent standardizing a “bigger usb c” to be used in ebikes.
My bosch ebike controller is a very lousy timekeeper, and the only way to set the clock is with an app.
